I don't trust this President.

He said he would get us out of wars, he got us in one. He promised to lower prices, now they are skyrocketing.

While he's focused on a ballroom, Americans are paying the price for his war.

This man...a Master Class in – despite it all – finding joy and sharing it with others. 

Thank you.

I just returned from Birmingham, Alabama - sacred ground where Americans were beaten, jailed, terrorized, and even killed for the simple but powerful right to vote.

Too many people want us to believe voter suppression is history. It is not.

Across our nation, we are watching new barriers rise, new tactics emerge, and old fears dressed up in modern language. The targets may change, the methods may evolve, but the purpose is painfully familiar: to silence voices and diminish power.

This Teacher Appreciation Week, let us honor the people who change lives often without applause, riches, or recognition.

A great teacher does more than teach lessons.
They build confidence.
They awaken curiosity.
They help children believe they matter and that their dreams matter too.

Long after students forget the homework or the test, they remember the teacher who saw them, encouraged them, challenged them, and loved them enough to help them grow.

We must stand up  in Congress, in the courts, and at the ballot box. Our democracy demands nothing less.

I'm just back from Birmingham, Alabama where people paid for the right to vote with sweat, blood, and even their lives.

A dark moment in our nation’s history is repeating. But we must remember that we are not powerless.

We must stand up and continue to fight to ensure our voices are heard, just like the generations who came before us.

Most Americans agree the Supreme Court should not have the most relaxed ethics laws in the country.

Most Americans – Republican and Democrat – don’t think justices should be able to hold onto their seats forever.

Video

In a time when cruelty and crassness;
meanness and mercilessness;
seem to command the spotlight,

let’s not forget:

Our world is still filled with goodness.
With quiet courage.
With helpers, healers, and everyday heroes.

They may not trend,
but they transform lives.

We need more of that.
And more importantly…
we must be more of that.

The Trump Administration is at war with science, evidence and truth.

Video

Trump and other Republicans are actively working to undermine free and fair elections -  right ahead of the midterm elections.

However, we are not powerless. There is a movement of people fighting back and often winning. 

I am grateful for the Brennan Center and so many others who are standing for democracy, fairness and justice. 

We must continue the work.

I introduced new legislation to review and unwind the anti-competitive corporate mergers rushed through under the Trump administration. 

This bill will help reverse dangerous media consolidation and restore competition. 

Let this be clear: those who break our laws or ignore them to appease Donald Trump should be held accountable.

Video

This is what happens when we let vanity and ego drive our government. $400 million in taxpayer dollars for Trump's vanity projects? While families struggle with housing, healthcare, and the cost of living? 

We can—and must—do better.
